name: Pursuit Managed Services
purpose: An interactive session app for Deloitte client visits: participants answer short activities on iPads, a facilitator runs the day and shows live results, leaders get a report. Three single-file HTML pages that run from a SharePoint document folder and keep their data in SharePoint lists, through the browser's own sign-in; no server, no CDN.
runtime: three static HTML pages in one SharePoint document folder; same-origin SharePoint REST (/_api) with the signed-in user; settings in pms-config.txt beside the pages

lists.title: PMSClients
lists.purpose: One item for each client: its name, its slug and its look.

lists.title: PMSClientSessions
lists.purpose: One item for each client and day: the session participants join when it is live.

lists.title: PMSActivities
lists.purpose: The activities: each belongs to one client and holds its questions in order.

lists.title: PMSAnswerOptions
lists.purpose: The answers a question offers, including which one is right.

lists.title: PMSParticipants
lists.purpose: One item for each visit: one person on one device in one session.

lists.title: PMSGuestQRCodes
lists.purpose: One item for each single-use QR code.

lists.title: PMSAppSettings
lists.purpose: One item, `default`: which session and client are live, and the version of the lists. Every page reads it first. Setup writes it when it makes the lists; nobody makes it by hand.

lists.title: PMSGuestList
lists.purpose: The guest list: one item for each named guest of a session.

lists.title: PMSVisitLog
lists.purpose: The visit log: one row for each browser tab that opened the participant page. Results read it for names.

lists.title: PMSAdminUsers
lists.purpose: The facilitators who may unlock the admin page: a name and a hash of a PIN each.

lists.title: PMSParticipantAnswers
lists.purpose: The answers: one item for each visit, holding all of that person's answers.

commands.npm run dev: the local server (API and pictures, no page) on port 3000
commands.npm run dev:svelte: the participant page from Vite (5173); dev:svelte:admin 5175, dev:svelte:setup 5176
commands.npm run build:svelte:release: build the three pages into build-svelte/release/
commands.npm run test:migration: build and run the browser specs (Chromium, WebKit, Firefox)
commands.npm run test:report: the leader report, CSVs and summary pack, read back
commands.npm run test:report:mutations: the report tests catch deliberate breakages
commands.npm run oracle -- --seeds 500: recount 500 random sessions with independent rules
commands.npm run test:charts: the Results charts' numbers and palette
commands.npm run test:bundle: page sizes and what the participant page must not carry
commands.npm run local:site -- --open: the local PCOE stand-in, serving the newest release package
commands.npm run package:release: the release package (clean committed tree only)
commands.npm run docs:check: the documents name only what is there

folders.migration/src: The three entries (`main.ts`, `admin-main.ts`, `setup-main.ts`), the three apps (`App.svelte`, `AdminApp.svelte`, `SetupApp.svelte`) and their page-wide CSS. The HTML shells are `migration/index.html`, `admin.html` and `setup.html`.
folders.migration/src/admin: The admin page's screens (Svelte): the five tabs, Brand Studio, dialogs, the Live display, the print sheet, the report buttons.
folders.migration/src/admin/charts: The Results charts, drawn by hand in HTML and SVG (no chart library): the card, bars, the scale, the split bar, words, names, the table view, the tooltip.
folders.migration/src/assets: Inlined assets: Open Sans as WOFF2, the report's TrueType subset, the six sample pictures.
folders.migration/src/assets/report-fonts: The Open Sans subset of the leader report (generated by `npm run build:report-fonts`, with its licence).
folders.migration/src/components: The participant page's building blocks (Svelte): the shell, pills, buttons, the hero plate, tiles, the progress bar, the sound switch.
folders.migration/src/dev: The styleguide, `#/styleguide` on the dev server only (absent from builds).
folders.migration/src/lib/admin: The admin page's rules and data: Today, Clients, Content, Guests and QR, Results, the Live display's session, the PIN check.
folders.migration/src/lib/brand: A client's look: deriving a readable theme from a colour, the stored theme, Brand Studio's rules, picture slots, cropping, compressing and naming.
folders.migration/src/lib/common: Shared by the pages: the product name, the heading focus rule, kiosk lock-down, the polling schedule and its one timer, the admin page's address.
folders.migration/src/lib/data: The data layer: the one module that talks to SharePoint REST (or, on the local server, its JSON API), and grouping of long id lists into short reads. Every page carries it.
folders.migration/src/lib/effects: Sounds and confetti, behind one door (`effects.ts`): which moment makes which effect, the cues as data, Web Audio, canvas-confetti.
folders.migration/src/lib/exports: The files a leader gets: the leader report (data, counting, layout, PDF writer, fonts) and the Live display's summary pack (PDF, PowerPoint) and summary CSV.
folders.migration/src/lib/motion: The participant screens' motion, behind one door (`motion.ts`): the plan by kind of question and part of a screen, the tokens and shapes (CSS), the level and the governor.
folders.migration/src/lib/participant: The participant page: the boot sequence, the visit, the activities held for the page's life, the pager's rules, saving answers, screen moves.
folders.migration/src/lib/results: Results counted and shown: the tally, the chart model (every number a chart shows), the palette, the figure on paper, names, the takeaways, where a tooltip goes.
folders.migration/src/lib/schema: The lists and columns: `pms-schema.js`, the names every page carries, and `pms-schema-meta.js`, everything else about them (Setup, the tests and the generators only).
folders.migration/src/lib/settings: How a page starts: the browser check, where its settings come from (`pms-config.txt`, the build, its address), which site and lists are its own, and the stop screen.
folders.migration/src/lib/setup: The Setup page's own modules: the plan and Create, Mark the site as ready, the admins, the seed-file import, the sample clients and their pictures, the self-test's probes.
folders.migration/src/pager: The pager: one question per screen, its answers, and an activity's completion screen.
folders.migration/src/routes: The participant page's screens: Welcome, the Activities hub, the quiz route, the finale, "not live", the preview, and the old addresses that redirect.
folders.migration/src/setup: Setup's pieces (Svelte): the copy panel, where the lists are, the plan view, and the sample pictures as data.
folders.migration/src/styles: Tokens (colour, type), the focus ring, the fonts (inlined Open Sans and the metric-matched fallback), the Results palette, and `legacy/`, the old sheets the pages still load.
folders.migration/src/unsupported: The "needs a recent browser" notice: a page and an ES5 check, put into each HTML shell at build time.
folders.scripts: Node tests (`test-*.js`, run by `npm test` and the `test:*` scripts), the mocked SharePoint (`sharepoint-fake.js`), the oracle, the bundle and request baselines, the generators and the release packager.
folders.scripts/local-site: The local PCOE stand-in (`npm run local:site`), its scenarios and VJR's dummy dataset, the screenshot harness and the measurements.
folders.scripts/migration-tests: The Playwright specs of `npm run test:migration`, and their harnesses (`admin-local.ts`, `polling-support.ts`, `fixtures.ts`).
folders.scripts/rehearsal-tests: The rehearsal of RUNBOOK.md on the mock with a package's own pages (`npm run test:rehearsal`).
folders.scripts/request-baseline: Every SharePoint request each recorded suite sends, as recorded at `legacy-final` and amended only on purpose (`npm run test:baseline`).
folders.scripts/schema-baseline: The schema as it was before Phase 10c-2b, and the scripts that translated the request baselines (each baseline names the one that touched it).
folders.server: The local stand-in for SharePoint: an Express API over JSON files (`server/data/`, committed seed data), with ETag concurrency and picture uploads. Development and tests only.
